_all.reason: Same reporting entity and connections to related financial statements are not established by this selected metric alone; no IFRS S1 compliance conclusion.

ghg_total_unspecified.reason: Reported total has no verified Scope 1/2/3 definition; it cannot be assigned to a specific disclosure.

ghg_scope1.reason: A Scope 1 amount alone does not establish gross emissions, boundary, gases or calculation method.

ghg_scope2.reason: Scope 2 value lacks reviewed location/market method, boundary and calculation basis.

ghg_intensity.reason: Denominator, included scopes and calculation method require review.

ghg_intensity_reduction.reason: A reduction in intensity is not automatically the absolute emission reduction requested by this disclosure.

eii.reason: EII or an EII target needs a reviewed definition before it can be treated as an energy intensity ratio.

solar_capacity.reason: Installed/planned MWp capacity is not energy consumption; no direct GRI 302-1 numerical comparison is available.

freshwater_use.reason: The record does not establish whether freshwater use means withdrawal or consumption; these are distinct disclosures.

waste_total.reason: Waste generated, scope and composition need confirmation; total waste is not necessarily disposal.

waste_hazardous.reason: Hazardous component and its relation to total generated waste need source review.

waste_nonhazardous.reason: Non-hazardous component and its relation to total generated waste need source review.

waste_recycled.reason: Recycling and reuse operations, on/off-site treatment and boundary need confirmation.

waste_other_treatment.reason: The Extract combines landfill and other final treatment; disposal operation breakdown is not verified.

employees_total.reason: Headcount/FTE, measurement date and employment boundary require review.

employees_male.reason: Gender breakdown requires the same employee population, method and date as total.

employees_female.reason: Gender breakdown requires the same employee population, method and date as total.

female_share.reason: Overall female share does not provide the employee-category breakdown requested by GRI 405-1.

male_share.reason: Overall male share does not provide the employee-category breakdown requested by GRI 405-1.

board_total.reason: Board size alone does not establish all governance composition disclosures.

board_independent.reason: Independent member count is only one aspect of governance composition.

chair_ceo_separate.reason: CEO separation alone may not establish whether the chair holds any other senior executive role.
